description: Java utility class 'UtilJavaParse' providing methods for parsing Java source files within an Apache OFBiz project; includes utilities for locating class files, extracting method blocks, identifying service and entity call references, and stripping comments.

classes.name: UtilJavaParse
classes.description: Final utility class for parsing Java source files related to OFBiz services and entities

methods.name: findRealPathAndFileForClass
methods.description: Locates the full filesystem path of a Java class file in OFBiz component sources based on class name

methods.name: findServiceMethodBlockStart
methods.description: Finds the start index of a specified service method block in a Java source file

methods.name: findEndOfBlock
methods.description: Determines the index of the end of a code block, given the start position

methods.name: findServiceCallsInBlock
methods.description: Identifies service calls within a code block by analyzing dispatcher calls

methods.name: findEntityUseInBlock
methods.description: Detects entity-related method calls within a code block

methods.name: stripComments
methods.description: Removes block and line comments from Java source code
